evals.name: print-readiness-review-webrtc
evals.prompt: I'm sending the Streamlit-WebRTC poster to the print shop this week. Can you go over it and tell me if anything is going to bite me? Don't change any files yet, I just want to know what you find.
assertions: Opens with a short ranked list of the worst problems before the detailed findings
Reports that callout boxes paint over hero code lines, making the Python read as broken
Reports that the footer spends the poster root's declared 15mm bottom padding down to under 2mm
Reports the ~11pt MacWindow titlebar as below the legibility floor
Reports that the heart glyph is drawn by a host font rather than a package-locked family
Reports that an arrow glyph in the media-routing diagram falls back to a host font
States explicitly which checks came back clean rather than only listing problems
Modified no repository file outside its own outputs directory

evals.name: svg-diagram-label-size
evals.prompt: Something's been bugging me about the media routing diagram on the streamlit-webrtc poster. The little labels under SINK/FILTER/SOURCE feel too small to me but the CSS says 18px and 21px which should be fine right? Can you check whether they actually clear our legibility floor at A1. Read-only please.
assertions: States that SVG font-size is in user units rather than CSS pixels, so the declared px values do not convert directly to points
Gives a measured printed size for the labels in the 16.5-17.5pt range
Does NOT claim the 18px label equals 13.5pt (the naive px-to-pt conversion)
Concludes the labels fall below the 18pt floor, correcting the user's assumption
Measured the rendered poster rather than only reading CSS
Modified no repository file outside its own outputs directory

evals.name: stlite-pre-final-review
evals.prompt: I think the Stlite poster is done. Before I mark it final, give it a once-over for print problems. Please don't edit anything.
assertions: Opens with a short ranked list or clear verdict before the detailed findings
States that no text falls below the 18pt floor and nothing is clipped
Reports the full-sheet white background fill that survives into the PDF
Reports that .transport__arrow names a font family that is not package-locked, so its text falls back to a host font
Reports that an arrow glyph in the ASGI layer label is drawn by a host font
Does NOT report the deliberate -15mm logo margin or the cropped logo box as defects
Surfaces the brief's open decisions as the author's to make rather than resolving them
Modified no repository file outside its own outputs directory
